backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Somers Scheduler backend, defining data models and logic for user profiles, win/loss stats, leaderboard scoring, daily logs, availability, posts/reactions, and badge definitions/awards with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three win-streak bug-fix features (current streak, best streak on ProfilePage, and streak on LeaderboardPage) to their affected files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, used as a reference for build planning and code navigation.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom-property design tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, chart palette, sidebar) and applies base border and background styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Somers Scheduler PWA, including viewport/theme meta tags, PWA manifest link, favicon, iOS home-screen and splash-screen assets, and the React root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest for Somers Scheduler, specifying app name, display mode, theme/background colors, orientation, and icon URLs for 192×192 and 512×512 sizes.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page shown by the service worker when the user has no network connection, featuring a styled message and a reload button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing install-time precaching of core assets, old-cache cleanup on activate, and a network-first fetch strategy with cache fallback and an offline HTML page for navigation requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up routing with TanStack Router and an AuthGate component handling Internet Identity authentication, actor initialization, leaderboard setup, and profile loading with error/loading states.
frontend/src/components/admin/BadgeManag: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting badge definitions with criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames), a form modal, and delete confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple full-page card component displayed when a non-admin user attempts to access a restricted admin page, with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page with a background image, app logo, and a single Internet Identity sign-in button that shows a loading state while authenticating.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple image component that renders the app logo using the URL and alt text from the branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Main chat UI card that displays a threaded post list, handles new message submission with optional image attachments and upload progress, and uses React Query for fetching and creating posts.
frontend/src/components/chat/DeleteMessa: Alert dialog component that prompts the user to confirm permanent deletion of a chat message, with a disabled state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: File input component for selecting and previewing an image attachment in the chat, with validation and the ability to clear the selection.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Like/dislike button controls for a chat post that apply optimistic UI updates and call add/remove reaction mutations, reverting on error.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: A form component for composing and submitting replies to a parent post, supporting text input and optional image attachments with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive threaded tree of posts with support for inline editing, deletion, reactions, and reply composition, with indentation based on depth.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: A reusable error alert component that displays a title, message, and optional retry or secondary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading indicator components: a full-page centered spinner and an inline spinner, both with configurable messages and sizes.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout wrapper that composes the offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer for the application.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with links to Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin pages, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides reusable Page and PageHeader layout primitives with configurable max-width and optional icon/action slots.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Application header displaying the app logo, title, theme toggle, PWA install button, and a user avatar dropdown with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileB: Displays a user's earned badges fetched from the backend, showing icons, names, descriptions, and criteria labels with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Displays and allows editing of the current user's profile card, including name editing and avatar image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the current user's all-time leaderboard rank by finding their principal in the leaderboard data.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Renders the caller's match history as a list of daily win/loss records, with loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name before proceeding, saving it via the profile mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileW: Renders a filterable bar chart of wins and losses over selectable time ranges (week, month, year, all-time) using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: A dialog providing step-by-step instructions for installing the app to the home screen, with separate flows for iOS and Android.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Displays a fixed top banner when the user loses network connectivity, listening to browser online/offline events.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children in a full-screen container with a faint fixed court background image.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback alongside a display name, supporting multiple size variants and a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and check whether they have admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook that detects PWA installability, handles the beforeinstallprompt event, and exposes a promptInstall function along with iOS and standalone mode detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, availability, leaderboard, posts, and other data fetching and mutation operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook that manages light/dark theme state, persists the preference to localStorage, and toggles the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and cache display names and avatars for lists of principals by querying user profiles from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/component/utility layers, CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and safe-area/layout utilities for PWA standalone mode.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports a single BRANDING constant object containing the app name, logo URL, and logo alt text for the Somers Scheduler app.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Utility functions to build a nested thread tree from a flat list of posts and flatten it into a depth-annotated list for rendering.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Date utility functions for converting between Date objects and numeric day IDs, generating calendar grids, and formatting dates and timestamps for display.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: A form page that allows users to add or edit their availability for a specific date, with time (hour/minute/AM-PM) and notes fields, pre-populating existing data if available.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: An admin-only panel that displays and manages registered users, their availabilities, and login timestamps, with delete actions and a badge management section.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: A monthly calendar view showing per-day availability counts with navigation between months, each day linking to its detail page, plus an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: A simple full-page wrapper around the ChatPanel component for displaying the group chat.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: A detail page for a specific date that lists all users who marked availability, and allows the current user to add, edit, or delete their own availability entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: A leaderboard page showing ranked users with win/loss records, allowing the current user to record or remove daily wins/losses for their available days, and computing their current win streak.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile page with stats including win/loss history, leaderboard ranks, badges, and streak calculations. Contains `computeBestStreak` and `computeCurrentStreak` helpers that derive streaks from chronological match history win/loss records.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utility functions for file handling: converting a File/Blob to Uint8Array, extracting name initials for avatar fallback, and validating image file type and size.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utility functions for time input handling, including generating hour/minute/period options, formatting time components into a string, and parsing a time string back into components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, box shadow, accordion keyframes, and plugins (typography, container-queries, animate).
project_state.json: Tracks project state at version 3, documenting existing features and a pending action request (AR-1) to fix win streak calculations in the ProfilePage and LeaderboardPage to use consecutive match win/loss records instead of days played.
